title: TIMEYARD Small Wicker Plant Basket, Planter for Indoor Plants, Black Jute | 8" x 8" Storage Organizer Basket Rustic Home Decor, Wicker Planter, Woven Pot for Indoor Plants

reviews.title: Perfect boho plant basket sturdy and looks great in my space
reviews.body: love these plant baskets. I used them for my indoor plants and they were exactly what I was looking for to warm up the space and add a boho touch.The jute material feels sturdy and well made, not flimsy or cheap. They hold their shape really well and look great styled on plant stands or directly on the floor. I especially like the neutral color because it blends easily with different decor styles without standing out too much.They instantly made my room feel more finished and cozy. If you’re trying to soften a space or add texture without going overboard, these are perfect.Pros:• Sturdy, high-quality material• Great for boho or neutral decor• Holds its shape well• Looks beautiful with indoor plantsCons:• No liner included, so I use them with an inner pot (not a dealbreaker)Overall, I’m really happy with these and would definitely buy them again. They’re a great decorative option for plant lovers

reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.body: I love the color combination, adds just enough texture but doesn’t detract from the plant. Good price, much less expensive than a large planter. I was a bit concerned about folds not releasing as some reviews stated but  picture is right after unfolding, needed very little reshaping needed. I knew it wasn’t lined but the original pot fit in a tallish 2 gal bucket with space at the bottom for drainage so lining nit an issue. Very happy with this basket.

features: Good Material and Size: Handcrafted meticulously with jute and sewn in a coiling method that results in a flexible textile that is stiff enough to hold its shape. Approximate size is 8" Diameter x 8" High. Pot and plant are not included

Best Fits 5-7'' Flower Pot: Ideal for potted house plant and fits cylinder flower plant pot from 5" up to 7.5" in diameter. If your favorite plants are using ordinary plastic flower pots, ceramic planter or grow bags, cotton rope pot covers will provide unique charm with cactus, succulents

Rustic Modern Home and Lifestyle: This striking black-bottomed hand woven cotton rope planter basket adds a modern flair to your favorite large plant for home, hotels, offices, and restaurants for an instant feeling of rustic simplicity

Foldable and Unique: Handles are sturdy and not easy to be broken. The plant basket is easy to move, foldable and can save space when not in use. Due to the handmade items, each plant basket is individual and there may be slight variations from one to another. A perfect housewarming gift or unique gift
Multiuse for Different Scene: This neutral woven basket is also great to use as a storage bin for office supplies, fruit, vegetables, diaper or other small items
